about: Health: exercise, check-ups, serious illness, depression and care in old age.

opts.do: T('gym', { kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.gym') }); rec('gym', .06 * base, 10, .8)
const r = evR('runOn'); rec('', 0, r() < .4 ? 10 : 1, .5); happy += 1; if (r() < .12) { health -= 4; pay(.05 * base); }

en..x: You sit at a desk all day, and it is starting to show.
en..run.s: Free, if you keep it up. Happiness +1.
en..run.h: Health +0.5 a year while you keep it up: about 4 in 10 people do. About 1 in 8 get a running injury.

zh..x: 你整天坐在办公桌前，身体开始出状况了。
zh..run.s: 不花钱，只要坚持得下去。幸福感 +1。
zh..run.h: 坚持跑的话，健康每年 +0.5；大约十个人里有四个能坚持。大约八分之一的人会跑步受伤。

zht..x: 你整天坐在辦公桌前，身體開始出狀況了。
zht..run.s: 不花錢，只要堅持得下去。幸福感 +1。
zht..run.h: 堅持跑的話，健康每年 +0.5；大約十個人裡有四個能堅持。大約八分之一的人會跑步受傷。

en..x: A full health screening costs {a}. You feel fine.
en..yes.h: Problems caught early cost less: medical bills 30% lower from now on.

zh..x: 一次全面体检要{a}。你觉得身体很好。
zh..yes.h: 早发现，花得少：以后的医药费低30%。

zht..x: 一次全身健檢要{a}。你覺得身體很好。
zht..yes.h: 早發現，花得少：以後的醫藥費低30%。

opts.do: ltc = true; T('ltc', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.ltc') }); rec('ltc', .025 * base, 99); care()

later.care: if (roll('care') >= .4) return; const amt = .8 * base; rec('', amt * (ltc ? .3 : 1), 3, 0); if (ltc) { const t = trk.ltc; if (t) { t.v += amt * .7 * 3; t.note = M('note.ltcPaid', {a: MN(amt * .7 * 3)}) } } log(M(ltc ? 'log.careIns' : 'log.care', {a: MN(amt)}), 'bad')

en..x: A care home or a daily carer can cost {a} a year. Insurance would pay most of it.
en..h: About 4 in 10 people need long-term care.
en..yes.s: About {a} a year for the rest of your life.
en..no.s: Keep the money. If you need care, you pay for it.

zh..x: 住养老院或请全天看护，每年可能要{a}。保险会付大部分。
zh..h: 大约每10个人里有4个需要长期护理。
zh..no.s: 钱留着。真的需要护理时自己付。

zht..x: 住安養機構或請全天看護，每年可能要{a}。保險會付大部分。
zht..h: 大約每10個人裡有4個需要長期照顧。
zht..no.s: 錢留著。真的需要照顧時自己付。

opts.do: insured = false; const t = trk.ins; if (t) t.note = M('note.insDrop', { p: MN(t.prem), c: MN(t.saved) })

en..x: Because of your age, your health insurance premium is jumping to {a} a year.
en..keep.s: {a} a year. Big bills stay 85% covered.
en..drop.s: Save the premium. You pay all medical bills yourself.

zh..x: 因为年纪大了，你的医疗保险保费要涨到每年{a}。
zh..drop.s: 省下保费。以后医药费全部自己付。
zh.note.insDrop: 已付保费{p} · 已报销{c} · 已退保

zht..x: 因為年紀大了，你的醫療險保費要漲到每年{a}。
zht..drop.s: 省下保費。以後醫藥費全部自己付。
zht.note.insDrop: 已付保費{p} · 已理賠{c} · 已解約

en..x: Your hip needs replacing. The public waiting list is about 18 months.
en..priv.s: About {a}{ins}. Back on your feet in weeks. Happiness +3.
en..wait.s: Free, but 18 months of pain. Happiness −3.

zh..x: 你的髋关节需要置换。公立医院要排队大约18个月。
zh..priv.s: 大约{a}{ins}。几个星期就能下床走路。幸福感 +3。
zh..wait.s: 不花钱，但要痛18个月。幸福感 −3。
zh.trk.hipPriv: 私立医院做髋关节手术

zht..x: 你的髖關節需要置換。公立醫院要排大約18個月。
zht..priv.s: 大約{a}{ins}。幾個星期就能下床走路。幸福感 +3。
zht..wait.s: 不花錢，但要痛18個月。幸福感 −3。
zht.trk.hipPriv: 私立醫院做髖關節手術

en..x: You keep asking people to repeat themselves.
en..none.s: Save the money. Conversations get harder. Happiness −1.

zh..x: 你常常要别人把话再说一遍。
zh..none.s: 省下这笔钱，但聊天越来越吃力。幸福感 −1。

zht..x: 你常常要別人把話再說一遍。
zht..none.s: 省下這筆錢，但聊天越來越吃力。幸福感 −1。

events.src: health: a serious illness and depression come with the situation (see tick); `surv` makes the 40 futures count survivors

opts.ok: k === 'best' ? (insured || liq >= .5 * y || M('e.home.need', {n: MN(.5 * y), h: MN(liq)})) : undefined

en..x.heart: Chest pain sends you to hospital: it's a heart attack. Once you're stable, the doctors explain your treatment options.
en..x.stroke: One morning your arm goes weak and your words come out wrong: it's a stroke. Once you're stable, the doctors explain your treatment options.
en..x.cancer: A check-up finds cancer. The doctors explain your treatment options.
en..hx: Your chances depend on your health, your age, your country and the treatment.
en..best: The best hospital you can find
en..best.s: About {a}{ins}: top specialists and no waiting.{off}
en..skip.s: No hospital bills. You rest at home.{off}

zh..x.heart: 胸口一阵剧痛，你被送进医院：是心脏病发作。情况稳定下来以后，医生向你说明了几种治疗方案。
zh..x.stroke: 一天早上，你的手臂突然没力气，话也说不清楚：是中风。情况稳定下来以后，医生向你说明了几种治疗方案。
zh..x.cancer: 一次体检发现了癌症。医生向你说明了几种治疗方案。
zh..hx: 能不能挺过去，取决于你的健康、年龄、所在的国家和治疗方式。
zh..best.s: 大约{a}{ins}：顶尖的专科医生，不用排队。{off}

zht..x.heart: 胸口一陣劇痛，你被送進醫院：是心臟病發作。情況穩定下來以後，醫生跟你說明了幾種治療方式。
zht..x.stroke: 某天早上，你的手臂突然沒力氣，話也說不清楚：是中風。情況穩定下來以後，醫生跟你說明了幾種治療方式。
zht..x.cancer: 一次健康檢查發現了癌症。醫生跟你說明了幾種治療方式。
zht..hx: 能不能撐過去，取決於你的健康、年齡、所在的國家和治療方式。
zht..best.s: 大約{a}{ins}：頂尖的專科醫師，不用排隊。{off}

en..x: For two years you've felt flat and tired, and the things you used to enjoy don't help. A doctor says it's depression: a common health condition that can be treated, not a weakness.
en..h: While it lasts: pay −30%, fewer promotions, health slowly falls, and your focus works half as well.
en..care: If you're struggling in real life, talking to someone helps.
en..ther.h: It usually lifts in one to two years.
en..off.s: Four months off: about {a} less pay this year.
en..off.h: It usually lifts within one to two years.
en..talk.s: Free. Tell the people close to you how you've been feeling.
en..talk.h: The closer your relationships, the sooner it lifts: one to four years.
en..ignore.s: Keep going as if nothing is wrong.
en..ignore.h: It usually lasts four to six years.
en.log.dep: A doctor tells you it's depression.

zh..x: 这两年你一直提不起劲、很疲惫，以前喜欢的事也帮不上忙。医生说这是抑郁症：一种常见、可以治疗的健康问题，不是软弱。
zh..h: 持续期间：收入 −30%，升职机会变少，健康慢慢下降，每年重心的效果减半。
zh..care: 如果你在现实生活中也觉得很辛苦，找人聊聊会有帮助。
zh..off.s: 休息四个月：今年少赚大约{a}。
zh..off.h: 通常一到两年内会好转。
zh..talk.s: 不花钱。把你这阵子的感受告诉身边的人。
zh..talk.h: 关系越亲近，好得越快：一到四年。
zh.log.dep: 医生告诉你，你得了抑郁症。

zht..x: 這兩年你一直提不起勁、很疲累，以前喜歡的事也幫不上忙。醫生說這是憂鬱症：一種常見、可以治療的健康問題，不是軟弱。
zht..h: 持續期間：收入 −30%，升遷機會變少，健康慢慢下降，每年重心的效果減半。
zht..care: 如果你在現實生活中也覺得很辛苦，找人聊聊會有幫助。
zht..off.s: 休息四個月：今年少賺大約{a}。
zht..off.h: 通常一到兩年內會好轉。
zht..talk.s: 不用花錢。把你這陣子的感受告訴身邊的人。
zht..talk.h: 關係越親近，好得越快：一到四年。
zht.log.dep: 醫生告訴你，你得了憂鬱症。

opts.do: health -= 2; happy += 3; const t = T('y_party', {kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.y_party')}); t.spent += .05 * base; t.g += .05 * base
happy += 1; const t = T('y_party', {kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.y_party')}); t.spent += .015 * base; t.g += .015 * base

en..x: A friend talks you into signing up for a marathon next spring.
